findings.one_line: The displayed coefficient a(beta) is false in the stated class: with Var(Delta_T)=(4/k)(I_F otimes S_n)+o(k^-1), Delta_T=(2/sqrt{k})(I_F otimes S_n^{1/2})Z, so the limiting acceptance score and explained loss require the congruence (I_F otimes S_nu^{1/2}) G_infty (I_F otimes S_nu^{1/2}) (and likewise M_beta), not raw G_infty and M_beta; equations (5)--(10) omit this factor unless S_nu=I.

Its Gaussian action-regret derivation repeats the raw-coordinate error: after standardizing sqrt{N} Delta_T, the limit of each finite quadratic score is a congruence-transformed H, while (13)--(18) optimize raw g_beta(Z)=Z^T G_infty Z; the lower-tail comparison must be redone with the transformed oracle loss score.

cited_checks.note: The supplied verbatim Theorems 4--5 give the complete-randomization covariance and joint CLT; their equal-cell common-vector-array specialization yields the stated partition limit, and second-moment convergence follows from the exact covariance with S_k -> S.
